dependency_sharing.pair_members: selected together by pair draw; source-group draws are independent between members
dependency_sharing.selected_model_seeds: source-group draws are shared across all selected seed occurrences

draw_order: draw the full replicate-by-8 model-seed index array
draw the full replicate-by-20 pattern-pair index array
draw the full replicate-by-20-by-2-by-34 source-group index array

decision_gate.inconclusive_rule: precision gate passes and no directional or equivalence rule passes
decision_gate.negative_rule: point estimate <= -1.0 pp and 95% upper endpoint < 0
decision_gate.null_rule: complete 95% interval is contained in [-0.5,+0.5] pp
decision_gate.positive_rule: point estimate >= +1.0 pp and 95% lower endpoint > 0

estimand.effect_unit: one model seed by one target semantic pattern
estimand.formula: tau_pp = 100/(8*40) * sum_seed sum_pattern [accuracy(exposed arm, frozen 200 rows) - accuracy(unexposed arm, same frozen 200 rows)]
estimand.name: paired_sentence_permutation_exposure_effect
estimand.row_weighting: equal across the 200 frozen evaluation rows within each target pattern

exposure_alignment.algorithm: For each model seed and target semantic ID, identify the arm containing exactly 64 frozen exposure rows as exposed and the complementary zero-row arm as unexposed.

calibration.aggregation: Compute exposed-aligned and unexposed-aligned metrics separately within each model seed over all 8000 rows, subtract, then average the eight seed differences.
calibration.binning: 15 equal-width confidence bins on [0,1], with 1 included in the final bin

source_group_bootstrap.group_order: ascending source_group_id within each target pattern
source_group_bootstrap.row_aggregation: sum paired correctness differences over every row in every sampled group occurrence, divided by the corresponding sum of sampled group sizes
source_group_bootstrap.short_group_handling: the registered two-row group is sampled as one cluster and retains two rows; each registered six-row group retains six rows
